name: Blazing Bolero
body:
Requirement: Perform 3 ranks

Base effect: Whenever an ally within 30 feet is attacked with a non-reach melee weapon, the attacker suffers damage equal to 1d6 + your siren level. This damage is half fire, half sonic.

Refrain

You summon searing flames in a 10-feet burst centered on any creature within Medium range. The creatures in this area suffer fire damage, which is halved on a successful Reflex save.

Weak Refrain: Creatures in the area suffer 1d4 points of damage per siren level (max 4d4).

Intermediate Refrain: Creatures in the area suffer 1d6 points of damage per siren level (max 8d6).

Strong refrain: Creatures in the area suffer 1d8 points of damage per siren level (max 12d8).
